settings_blocked.import_status_rate_limited: Grindr asked to slow down. Trying again at {{time}}.
settings_blocked.import_status_retry: The last block didn't go through. Trying again in {{seconds}} s.
settings_blocked.instant_note_speed: It sends {{concurrency}} blocks at a time with no pauses, one round straight after another, so {{count}} profiles take about {{duration}}. Not literally all at once: that many requests together would mostly fail and freeze the app.
settings_blocked.instant_note_risk: A burst like this is what spam detection looks for. Grindr may slow the account down, restrict it or ban it, and GrindFlop can't undo that. It's safest on an account you could afford to lose; on your main account, pick a slower pace.
settings_blocked.instant_note_chats: Anyone on the list you've chatted with loses that chat, on both sides. A list from someone else can include people you talk to.
settings_blocked.instant_note_stop: If Grindr says too many requests or refuses the account, it stops at once instead of pushing on. The rest wait here: resume later, at a slower pace.
settings_blocked.instant_note_undo: Undoing it is slow: Unblock All also removes the blocks you made yourself, otherwise it's one profile at a time.
settings_blocked.instant_note_open: Keep GrindFlop open and in front until it finishes, especially on iOS. The app may be slower while it runs.

explicit.title: Explicit photos
explicit.cover_desc: Every photo and video you receive is checked on this device before it is shown, including the ones inside shared albums. Explicit ones, ones the detector is unsure about and ones it could not check stay covered. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
explicit.block_sender_desc: Blocks someone as soon as a photo or video they send, or one inside an album they share, shows genitals, anus or bare buttocks, before you are notified. Shirtless photos are left alone. Only blocks when the detector is sure; a photo it is unsure about stays covered and nobody is blocked. People on your whitelist are never blocked by this. Only applies to messages received from now on.
explicit.block_profile_photo_desc: When someone messages you, their profile photos are checked too, and an explicit one blocks them the same way, even if all they sent was a hello. Same rules: only when the detector is sure, never your whitelist, only for messages received from now on.
explicit.hide_in_albums_desc: Inside an album someone shares, on album covers and in a chat's media list, anything not cleared is drawn as a hidden tile, with Show anyway next to it. Off, those are shown as they are. Photos in the conversation itself stay covered, and blocking is not affected.
explicit.hide_profile_photos_desc: A profile photo the detector called explicit is drawn as a hidden tile wherever it would appear: chats, Interest, the Grid, Stats and profile screens, with Show anyway on the profile. Off, those photos are shown as they are. Blocking is not affected.
explicit.app_only: The photo detector only runs inside the app, not in a browser.
explicit.log_desc: Blocks made on what the detector saw, and the times it could not tell and left someone alone.
explicit.test_ok: Detector works on this device ({{ms}} ms per photo).
explicit.test_failed: Detector is not working on this device: {{error}}
explicit.per_device: Each device runs its own detector and has its own switch.

keywords.autosave: Everything in this section saves as soon as you change it.
keywords.select_to_ban_desc: Highlight part of a message, a bio or a Right Now post and the Ban keyword box opens on what you highlighted, ready to trim.
keywords.select_to_ban_note: Text can't normally be selected anywhere in the app — this turns selection back on for those three places only, so dragging still scrolls everywhere else.
keywords.forbidden_desc: Blocks people by their name, bio or messages. Every keyword blocks one of two ways — tap the label on a keyword to switch it.
keywords.whole_desc: Blocks only if the message says nothing else. "hot" blocks a message that just says "Hot!", but not "you look hot".
keywords.anywhere_desc: Blocks as soon as it shows up in the message. "telegram" blocks "add me on telegram".

openers.whole_desc: Their first message is exactly this. "hot" catches "Hot!", but not "hey hot".
openers.anywhere_desc: Their first message contains this. "looking for" catches "ey looking for", and still ignores it later in the chat.
openers.intro: Only judges the first message someone ever sends you. Nothing here can block a word said later in the chat.
openers.hint_whole: Blocks only if their first message is exactly this.
openers.hint_anywhere: Blocks if their first message contains this.

rules.first_media_title: Block if first message is Media.
rules.first_media_desc: Catches bots that open with pictures, videos, or albums without text (even if they send multiple media messages).
rules.link_bots_desc: Someone whose messages are all a bare link (like "bassew.com"), and whom you never wrote to, is a bot or a hacked account: they are blocked, and their chat is deleted instead of kept in the archive.
rules.link_bots_title: Block and delete chats that are only a link.
rules.active_chats_desc: Automatically whitelists and stops auto-blocking a profile once you have sent them messages.
rules.left_on_seen_title: Block if Left on Seen / Read.
rules.left_on_seen_desc: Automatically blocks someone if they read your last message but don't reply within the set time.
rules.no_photo_title: Block Faceless Profiles with No Media.
rules.no_photo_desc: Automatically blocks profiles with no profile picture if they haven't sent any media (photos, videos, albums) after the set time from their first message.
rules.no_face_title: Block profiles whose photos show no face.
rules.no_face_desc: For people who have a profile picture, but none where their face can be seen: too far away, hidden behind a phone, body only. Same outcome with a longer wait of its own. Only when every one of their photos was checked on this device and none shows a face; if the detector is unsure, they are left alone. Only for chats that start after you switch this on.
rules.need_face_title: Only a photo or video of their face saves them.
rules.need_face_desc: Applies to both rules above. Without this, any media they send is enough. With it, photos that show no face do not count, in whatever order they come. A shared album counts when one of its photos shows a face. Anything that could not be checked still counts in their favour. Only for chats that start after you switch this on.

filters.right_now_desc: Automatically blocks profiles that currently have an active "Right now" status or post.
filters.twitter_title: Block Profiles Linking an X / Twitter Account.
filters.twitter_desc: An X handle on a profile is almost always an advert for NSFW or paid content (OnlyFans and the like). Instagram and Facebook links are left alone.
filters.twitter_note: The social links only arrive with the full profile, so this is applied by the inbox and views scanners and by live chats — not by the plain inbox list.
filters.looking_any: Block if they have ANY of these
filters.looking_any_desc: Blocks the profile if they have one or more of the selected tags.
filters.looking_only: Block ONLY if they exclusively want these
filters.looking_only_desc: Blocks the profile only if all their tags are in the selected list (e.g., if they exclusively want those tags).
filters.no_age_title: Block profiles with no age set.
filters.no_age_desc: Prevents profiles that hide their age from bypassing the age limit rules.

scanners.inbox_desc: Queues your unread inbox and safely scans profiles in the background to check against your block rules.
scanners.counter_block_desc: Automatically blocks users back instantly if they block you.

privacy.incognito_mode_desc: Stop the Grid from loading or refreshing, send no read receipts and report no profile views, so you leave fewer traces while you use the app.
privacy.incognito_mode_note: While this is on, the Grid stays empty, its background refresh stops, nobody is told you read their message, and opening a profile does not count as a view. Loading the Grid is what shows you as online, so this keeps you out of sight there. The rest of the app still talks to Grindr, so it lowers your visibility without promising that you look offline. Turning it off puts everything back at once.
privacy.send_read_receipts_desc: Let others see when you've read their messages. Turn this off to read messages without them knowing until you reply.
privacy.per_chat_overrides_desc: Show a button in the chat header to override the global setting for specific chats. Chats with read receipts hidden are highlighted in your Inbox.
privacy.read_receipts_hidden_badge: Read receipts hidden for this chat
privacy.record_profile_views_desc: Let people see that you've viewed their profile. Turn this off to browse profiles without leaving a trace.
privacy.read_receipts_grid_unread_note: With read receipts off, there's no way to tell the server you've read a message — so a chat can still show up as unread on the Grid even after you've read or deleted it.
privacy.media_scanner_desc: Adds a Scanner Hub to the photo viewer to instantly reverse-search images using Google Lens.
privacy.app_disguise_desc: Swap the app's home screen icon for a decoy, so it does not stand out when someone else looks at your phone.
privacy.app_disguise_note: iOS confirms each change with a message of its own. Only the icon changes: the name under it stays GrindFlop, and the app still opens on its usual start screen.
privacy.app_disguise_failed: The icon could not be changed.

customizability.show_stats_desc: Record what the Stats page needs: why people were blocked, where you were, when this device was collecting views, your profile edits and the profiles you open. It only writes when those things happen, nothing runs in the background, and the records sync with Google Drive. Turning this on applies to all your devices.
customizability.show_stats_failed: Could not change the Stats setting.
customizability.confirm_before_block_desc: Ask for confirmation before blocking a profile. Turn this off to block immediately, without a prompt.
customizability.confirm_before_unblock_desc: Ask for confirmation before unblocking a profile. Turn this off to unblock immediately, without a prompt.
customizability.confirm_before_delete_conversation_desc: Ask for confirmation before deleting a conversation. Turn this off to delete immediately, without a prompt.
customizability.confirm_before_open_link_desc: Ask before opening a link tapped in a chat message. Turn this off to open links straight away.
customizability.units_description: Choose how distance and height are displayed.
customizability.blur_incoming_media_description: Automatically blur images and videos in chats. On desktop, hover or click to reveal. In chats, revealed media resets when you leave and return.
customizability.hex_error: Enter a valid hex color like #22c55e or 22c55e
customizability.browse_grid_mobile_desc: Adjust how many profiles appear per row on mobile.

reveal_effect.title: Reveal Effect
reveal_effect.description: The reveal effect animates items as you scroll down. You can disable it or change its intensity.
reveal_effect.enable_desc: Show items with a subtle animation when they enter the viewport.

customizability.emoji_style_desc: System uses this computer's emoji, with Twemoji for any it can't draw. Twemoji uses it for every emoji.

behavior.subtitle: Manage confirmation prompts before blocking profiles or deleting chats, and which tools profiles offer.
behavior.location_finder_desc: Show Locate in a profile's menu. It finds roughly where someone is by moving your location on Grindr, which could get your account flagged.
behavior.background_execution_desc: Plays a silent sound so iOS keeps Grindflop running when you switch apps or lock the screen: the connection, notifications and automations go on working. Your music keeps playing. Leave Grindflop in the app switcher. Beta: some notifications can still arrive late or not at all. Uses more battery.
behavior.background_execution_unavailable: The background support check failed without providing a reason. See diagnostic details.
behavior.background_execution_no_response: The app did not answer the background support check. Retry to check again.
behavior.background_execution_invalid_response: The app answered with an unreadable status. See diagnostic details.
behavior.background_execution_security_api: The app could not access the iOS permission-checking API.
behavior.background_execution_entitlement_read: The app could not read its background permission. This does not establish that the permission is missing.
behavior.background_execution_entitlement_missing: The running app does not have the required background permission.
behavior.background_execution_system_api: A required iOS background API is unavailable on this device.
behavior.background_execution_webkit_api: A required WebKit background setting is unavailable on this device.
behavior.background_execution_webview: The app's web view is unavailable for the background support check.
behavior.background_execution_denied: iOS rejected the request to keep the app running. See diagnostic details.
behavior.background_execution_sound: The silent sound could not start, so iOS will pause Grindflop in the background. See diagnostic details.
behavior.background_execution_enabled: Enabled. Force-quitting or restarting the phone stops execution until you open Grindflop again.
behavior.background_execution_disabled: Disabled. iOS can suspend Grindflop in the background.
behavior.background_execution_failed: Background execution could not be confirmed or was interrupted by iOS. Return to the app and try again.
behavior.keep_screen_on_desc: Stop the screen from dimming or locking while the app is open and in front. Uses more battery.
behavior.auto_focus_location_search_desc: Put the cursor in the search field as soon as the location screen opens. Turn off if the keyboard coming up right away bothers you.
behavior.drawer_most_sent_first_desc: Show the photos and videos you send most often at the top of the drawer. Turn off to keep the order Grindr gives them.
behavior.default_expiring_photos_desc: A photo you attach or pick from the drawer starts out set to expire: it can be opened once, for 10 seconds. You can still change that before sending. Videos are not affected.
behavior.default_album_expiration_desc: How long someone keeps access to an album you share, unless you pick something else when sharing it.

location_finder.title: Location finder
location_finder.explain: Finds roughly where this person is. Your location on Grindr is moved to three points around them and their distance is measured from each one, over several rounds.

location_finder.risk: Moving your location over and over could get your account flagged or banned.

notifications_page.taps_enabled_desc: Get notified when someone taps you.

notifications_page.inbox_autoblock_desc: Get notified when a profile is automatically blocked from your inbox.
notifications_page.interest_autoblock_desc: Get notified when a viewer is automatically blocked from Interest Views.

errors.invalid_credentials: Invalid email or password. Please check your credentials and try again.
errors.invalid_token: This token is invalid or has expired. Please generate a new one and try again.

device.title: Grindr refused the request
device.description_sign_in: Grindr answered this sign-in with ACCOUNT_BANNED (code 28). That is often not a ban at all: it is also how Grindr turns down a request it does not trust, and an unofficial app is the usual reason. Every attempt here goes out as a new device, so trying again sometimes works. If the account still opens in the official Grindr app, it is not banned.
device.description_session: Grindr answered with ACCOUNT_BANNED (code 28) when the app renewed your session. That is often not a ban at all: it is also how Grindr turns down a request it does not trust, and an unofficial app is the usual reason. Signing out and in again goes out as a new device, which sometimes works. If the account still opens in the official Grindr app, it is not banned.

network.title: Grindr refused this network
network.description: Grindr will not accept a sign-in from the connection you are on. A VPN, a proxy or a shared network is the usual cause. Try again on another connection.

underage.title: Account banned
underage.description: Grindr has banned this account because it holds that its owner is under 18. Only Grindr can review that.

banned.title: Account banned
banned.description: Grindr has banned this account. It cannot be used until Grindr lifts the ban, and only Grindr can do that.

age_verification.title: Age verification required
age_verification.description: Grindr wants this account to prove its age before it can be used. That is done in the official Grindr app. This app does not get around age verification.

timed_ban.title: Temporarily banned
timed_ban.description: Grindr has banned this account for a limited time. It works again once the ban has run out.

restricted.title: Account restricted
restricted.description: Grindr has put a restriction on this account, and most of the app will not work while it lasts. The official Grindr app says what it wants from you.

session_expired.title: Sign in again
session_expired.description: This account was signed in with a token, and the token has run out. Grindr gave the app no way to renew it, so nothing will load until you sign in again.

realtime.meaning_green: Live connection to Grindr. New messages and profile views reach the app the moment they happen, and your blocking rules act within about a second.
realtime.meaning_orange: The live connection to Grindr is not working and the app keeps trying to restore it. Meanwhile, new messages and profile views only come in when the app refreshes, up to about 30 seconds late, so someone can write to you before your rules block them.
realtime.meaning_red: No live connection, and the app is not retrying right now: usually no internet, or the app was signed out. New messages and profile views come in late, or not at all without internet.

realtime.see_history: What the colours mean, and history

reset.desc: Puts the theme, layout, confirmations, notification switches and tab choices kept on this device back to their defaults. Blocking and automation rules, privacy, filters, sync, conversations and media are left alone.
reset.confirm_message: The theme, layout, confirmations, notification switches and tab choices on this device go back to their defaults, and the app reloads. Blocking and automation rules, privacy, filters, sync, conversations and media are not touched.

copy_settings.confirm_message_again: Brings {{name}}'s history over again: the memory of past contacts, and its messages, viewers and logs for Stats. Your settings on this account stay as they are. The app reloads when it's done.
copy_settings.title: Move from another account
copy_settings.desc: Brings over from an account that has data on this device: your settings, auto-block rules and keywords, filters, privacy, location, saved phrases and places, a memory of everyone that account talked to or blocked (shown in chats, the inbox and profiles), and its messages, viewers and logs so Stats counts both accounts together. Old chats don't appear in your inbox; the block list is imported on the Blocked page.
copy_settings.confirm_message: This account's settings are replaced with {{name}}'s. Its memory of past contacts is added, and its messages, viewers and logs are counted in Stats. Saved phrases and places are added to yours. Old chats don't appear in the inbox, and the block list doesn't move: use Import on the Blocked page. The app reloads when it's done.

data_backup.app_database_summary: {{size}} of cached chats, albums and avatars
data_backup.auto_download_media_desc: Also save every cached photo and video to your device's Downloads folder, in addition to the app's local database.
data_backup.backup_note: Exports are tied to your profile — a file can only be imported back into the same account it came from, so sign in on the other device first.
data_backup.delete_confirm_message: This permanently deletes every photo and video this app has saved to your device (manual saves and auto-downloads). The app's own local cache is not affected.
data_backup.delete_pruned_only: Cleared {{count}} entries — those files were already gone.
data_backup.delete_unsupported: Saved files can only be deleted from the installed app.

drive_sync.action_failed: Google Drive sync could not complete that action.
drive_sync.backup_first: Make a fresh manual backup before the first connection. Sync complements backups; it does not replace them.
drive_sync.core_desc: Chats, settings, rules, saved items, profile index and viewed-me history. Always on while sync is connected.
drive_sync.description: Automatically exchange encrypted changes between this profile's devices. Manual exports remain available as a separate recovery backup.
drive_sync.disconnect_message: This removes the Google connection and encryption key from this device. Your local GrindFlop data and encrypted cloud files stay intact. If this is the last paired device and you have not safely retained a pairing code, the cloud vault will become permanently unreadable.
drive_sync.encryption: Your laptop creates an end-to-end encrypted vault. Pair another device once with a private pairing code; Google cannot read the contents.
drive_sync.ios_note: On iPhone, catch-up starts the next time GrindFlop opens. iOS stops background sync after you swipe the app away.
drive_sync.load_failed: Could not read Google Drive sync status.
drive_sync.pair_another_desc: Reveal the encrypted vault's pairing code, then enter it on your other device. Anyone with this code can decrypt your synced data.
drive_sync.pairing_copied: Pairing code copied. Keep it private.
drive_sync.pairing_copy_failed: Could not copy the pairing code.
drive_sync.pairing_export_failed: Could not create a pairing code.
drive_sync.pairing_secret: Keep this code private. Hide it as soon as the other device is paired.
drive_sync.reauthorize_desc: If Google asks you to sign in again, refresh the connection here. Your encryption key and encrypted vault stay unchanged.
drive_sync.reauthorized_success: Google Drive sign-in was refreshed. Your encrypted vault was kept.
drive_sync.reset_message: Close or disconnect GrindFlop on every other paired device first. The app deletes the encrypted files it can verify and checks that the vault stays empty. If another device keeps uploading, deletion stops and this device keeps its key so you can retry. Local data is never erased.
drive_sync.reset_success: No sync-vault files remained after verification. This device was disconnected and local data was not changed. Keep other paired devices closed until they are reset or paired to a new vault.
drive_sync.title: Keep your devices in sync
drive_sync.unlock_vault_desc: Google is connected, but this device does not have the encryption key. Reveal the pairing code on your already-paired laptop and paste it here.
drive_sync.unavailable: Google Drive sync is not available in this build yet.
drive_sync.contact_scope_desc: Most of this index is profiles you only browsed past. Syncing just your conversations keeps phones fast; widen it if you want your browsing history on every device.
drive_sync.contact_scope_everything: Every profile ever seen (slow on phones)
drive_sync.pause_auto_desc: Stops background catch-up on this device so pairing and Sync now respond immediately. Nothing is lost; changes are still queued and sent on the next sync.

errors.oauth_not_configured: Google Drive OAuth is not configured in this build.
errors.oauth_unsupported: Google Drive OAuth is not supported on {{platform}}.

errors.pair_other_profile: This pairing code belongs to a different GrindFlop profile.
errors.pair_connect_first: Connect this device to the same Google account before importing the pairing code.
errors.pair_other_set: This profile is already enrolled in a different encrypted sync set.
errors.status_not_loaded: Google Drive sync status has not been loaded yet.
errors.not_configured: Google Drive sync is not configured in this build yet.

data_backup.export_success_ios: Saved to Files → On My iPhone → GrindFlop → {{name}}

data_backup.import_card_desc_mirror: Erase what's here and replace it with the file, making this device an exact copy. The app reloads afterwards.
data_backup.import_invalid: This file isn't a valid data export.

data_backup.import_no_user: You must be signed in to import.
data_backup.import_wrong_owner: This export belongs to a different profile and can't be imported here.
data_backup.mode_delta_desc: Only what changed since you last exported for {{name}}. Much smaller, and safe to merge on top of what's already there.
data_backup.mode_delta_first: This is the first export for {{name}}, so it includes everything. Later exports will only carry what changed.
data_backup.mode_full_desc: Everything selected below, regardless of what you've already sent.
data_backup.section_album_media_desc: Album contents and cover images. Usually the largest part of a backup.
data_backup.section_avatars_desc: Cached avatars, so restored profiles show their picture immediately.
data_backup.section_chat_media_desc: Cached media from your conversations, including view-once items that can't be re-fetched.
data_backup.section_core_desc: Conversations, messages, block history, saved phrases and locations, and every app setting.
data_backup.section_index_desc: Which profiles you've already chatted with, plus any nicknames you set. Restores the badges on the grid.
data_backup.section_local_desc: Auto-block rules, ghost mode, whitelist, scanner settings, notifications, and theme.
data_backup.section_views_desc: Profiles banked by the background scanner. Without these, locked views show as “Unknown Profile”.
data_backup.subtitle: Manage downloaded media and back up your account's entire data.
data_backup.title: Data
data_backup.manage_heading: Free up space on this device
